::: {.callout-warning}
## DEMONSTRATION PURPOSE ONLY

All data, center locations, KPI values, financial figures, and alert conditions displayed in this framework are **entirely simulated** and do not represent any real long-term care facility, government agency, or operational program. This site is intended solely as a **technical demonstration** of an OALTC KPI monitoring and reporting framework.
:::

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are measurable signals that show
whether OALTC programs are meeting goals in quality, operations,
compliance, workforce stability, and equity. A well-defined KPI
framework turns raw data into clear evidence for action by connecting
each metric to a business objective, ownership model, threshold, and
review cadence.

KPI tracking is important because it enables early risk detection,
faster corrective action, and more transparent reporting across teams.
By using standardized definitions and a consistent pipeline, OALTC can
compare performance over time, prioritize interventions, and support
leadership decisions with trusted, timely data.

Use the sidebar to navigate the full framework, requirement-gathering
structure, Section 3-4 demo outputs, and the interactive dashboard.
